title: 探偵事務所ドラマの口語表現

items.en: She looks pretty shaken up.
items.jp: 彼女はかなり動揺しているようです。
items.speak: She looks pretty shaken up.

items.en: Tell us what happened from the beginning.
items.jp: 最初から何があったか話してください。
items.speak: Tell us what happened from the beginning.

items.en: I have no idea how it happened.
items.jp: どうやって起きたのか全く見当がつきません。
items.speak: I have no idea how it happened.

items.en: Was there a break-in?
items.jp: 侵入されましたか？
items.speak: Was there a break-in?

items.en: The alarm never went off.
items.jp: 警報は鳴りませんでした。
items.speak: The alarm never went off.

items.en: Who has a key besides you?
items.jp: あなた以外に誰が鍵を持っていますか？
items.speak: Who has a key besides you?

items.en: We'll take the case.
items.jp: お引き受けします。
items.speak: We'll take the case.

items.en: There's no sign that anyone touched it.
items.jp: 誰かが触れた形跡はありません。
items.speak: There's no sign that anyone touched it.

items.en: Someone cleaned in a hurry and missed this.
items.jp: 誰かが急いで掃除して、ここを見逃しました。
items.speak: Someone cleaned in a hurry and missed this.

items.en: Whoever did this knew the code.
items.jp: 犯人は暗証番号を知っていました。
items.speak: Whoever did this knew the code.

items.en: Everyone's been looking at the wrong time.
items.jp: みんな間違った時間を見ていました。
items.speak: Everyone's been looking at the wrong time.

items.en: Thanks for seeing us.
items.jp: お会いくださってありがとうございます。
items.speak: Thanks for seeing us.

items.en: Did you notice anything unusual?
items.jp: 何か普通でないことに気づきましたか？
items.speak: Did you notice anything unusual?

items.en: Now that you mention it, there was a delivery man.
items.jp: そう言われれば、配達員がいました。
items.speak: Now that you mention it, there was a delivery man.

items.en: I didn't think twice about it.
items.jp: 深く考えませんでした。
items.speak: I didn't think twice about it.

items.en: Did you see his face?
items.jp: 顔は見えましたか？
items.speak: Did you see his face?

items.en: That doesn't match what he told me.
items.jp: それは彼が私に言ったことと合いません。
items.speak: That doesn't match what he told me.

items.en: One of them is mistaken, or he's lying.
items.jp: どちらかが間違っているか、嘘をついています。
items.speak: One of them is mistaken, or he's lying.

items.en: Let's not accuse him yet.
items.jp: まだ責めるのはやめましょう。
items.speak: Let's not accuse him yet.

items.en: Obvious answers are the most dangerous.
items.jp: 明らかな答えほど危険です。
items.speak: Obvious answers are the most dangerous.

items.en: Let's check the cameras.
items.jp: カメラを調べましょう。
items.speak: Let's check the cameras.

items.en: It's grainy, but you can see the alley.
items.jp: 荒いですが、路地が映っています。
items.speak: It's grainy, but you can see the alley.

items.en: There's no company logo at all.
items.jp: 会社のロゴがまったくありません。
items.speak: There's no company logo at all.

items.en: He was pretending to be a courier.
items.jp: 配達員のふりをしていました。
items.speak: He was pretending to be a courier.

items.en: Rewind it a bit.
items.jp: 少し巻き戻してください。
items.speak: Rewind it a bit.

items.en: That's enough to narrow it down.
items.jp: 絞り込むには十分です。
items.speak: That's enough to narrow it down.

items.en: Do you want to change your story?
items.jp: 話を変えたいですか？
items.speak: Do you want to change your story?

items.en: I swear I left right away.
items.jp: 誓ってすぐ出ました。
items.speak: I swear I left right away.

items.en: Nobody said you did.
items.jp: 誰もあなたがやったとは言っていません。
items.speak: Nobody said you did.

items.en: Who else knew about that?
items.jp: 他に誰がそれを知っていましたか？
items.speak: Who else knew about that?

items.en: I can't sleep.
items.jp: 眠れません。
items.speak: I can't sleep.

items.en: It doesn't fit anywhere.
items.jp: どこにも当てはまりません。
items.speak: It doesn't fit anywhere.

items.en: But wait, what if it wasn't the real one?
items.jp: でも待って、本物ではなかったら？
items.speak: But wait, what if it wasn't the real one?

items.en: Someone had to take it down and put it back up.
items.jp: 誰かが外して、また掛けなければなりませんでした。
items.speak: Someone had to take it down and put it back up.

items.en: Check the records for who worked on it.
items.jp: 誰が関わったか記録を調べてください。
items.speak: Check the records for who worked on it.

items.en: I'll find his name first thing in the morning.
items.jp: 朝一番に彼の名前を調べます。
items.speak: I'll find his name first thing in the morning.

items.en: We've solved it.
items.jp: 解決しました。
items.speak: We've solved it.

items.en: I'm afraid you won't like the answer.
items.jp: お気に召さない答えかもしれません。
items.speak: I'm afraid you won't like the answer.

items.en: I can't stand not knowing any longer.
items.jp: もう知らないままではいられません。
items.speak: I can't stand not knowing any longer.

items.en: It was a copy.
items.jp: それは複製でした。
items.speak: It was a copy.

items.en: He was blackmailing him over a debt.
items.jp: 借金をネタに彼を脅していました。
items.speak: He was blackmailing him over a debt.

items.en: He wanted everyone to think it was stolen last night.
items.jp: 皆に昨夜盗まれたと思わせたかったのです。
items.speak: He wanted everyone to think it was stolen last night.

items.en: The police arrested him this afternoon.
items.jp: 警察が今日の午後に彼を逮捕しました。
items.speak: The police arrested him this afternoon.

items.en: He's cooperating with the police.
items.jp: 彼は警察に協力しています。
items.speak: He's cooperating with the police.

items.en: I don't know what I would've done without you.
items.jp: あなたたちがいなければどうしていたか分かりません。
items.speak: I don't know what I would've done without you.

items.en: Case closed.
items.jp: 事件解決です。
items.speak: Case closed.

items.en: That's the strange part.
items.jp: そこが不思議なところです。
items.speak: That's the strange part.

items.en: It seems pretty obvious to me.
items.jp: 私にはかなり明らかに思えます。
items.speak: It seems pretty obvious to me.

items.en: Fair enough.
items.jp: もっともです。
items.speak: Fair enough.

items.en: Something doesn't add up.
items.jp: 何かつじつまが合いません。
items.speak: Something doesn't add up.
